articles.headline: Novartis's Christian Diehl on scaling AI beyond the demo
articles.summary: McKinsey interviews Novartis's chief AI officer Christian Diehl on the real-world challenges of moving AI from pilot projects to enterprise-scale deployment within a major pharmaceutical company. The conversation covers data infrastructure bottlenecks, organizational change management, and governance frameworks required to make AI operationally meaningful in drug development. It offers a candid, practitioner perspective on where biopharma AI actually stands versus the prevailing hype.
articles.why_it_matters: For investors and strategists tracking AI's tangible impact on drug development productivity, this piece offers rare ground-level visibility into how a top-5 pharma is building durable AI capability — a key differentiator in long-term pipeline velocity and R&D cost structure.

articles.headline: Elevance moves to require site-of-care details on hospital claims
articles.summary: Elevance Health is requiring hospitals to include physical site-of-care details on billing claims, enabling payment adjustments for off-campus outpatient services across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid lines. The policy targets the broader trend of hospitals billing at higher facility rates for services delivered at off-campus locations. This represents a structural reimbursement tightening move with meaningful financial implications for hospital systems and ambulatory surgery center operators.
articles.why_it_matters: ELV's policy directly pressures hospital outpatient revenue by closing a billing arbitrage gap, creating near-term headwinds for hospital operators and a potential tailwind for ASC-focused players — a concrete, investable payer dynamic.
